reviews.author: Chris Smith
reviews.text: Fantastic tree service. I have a small farm with lots of big trees. A few dead or dying that needed removal and others that needed significant trimming. Brian came out to learn what I wanted and give me an estimate. The crew came out as promised, did exactly what I wanted for the estimated price. A friendly and hard working crew who took care not to damage anything and leave the property very neat and clean. I highly recommend B&B Tree Service.

reviews.author: Ted Croom
reviews.text: B&B Tree Service arrived at our home on time and ready to get started. I met all his crew, they are all hard working and know what needs to be done without being constantly reminded. They are professional and one item important to me was the fact that they were all very safety conscious. They met their timeline to complete all I ask them to do and I couldn’t be happier! I would definitely recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Laurie Hanchar
reviews.text: Professional and compassionate service!! Tree climbing experts. Our 4 month old kitten was stuck in the tree and wedged between branches over 50ft up and they climbed the tree in less than 5 minutes to safely rescue the kitten. Excellent service!!!!! Thank you

reviews.author: Andrelo Bellamy
reviews.text: This is the 1st review I've ever posted. It's not something I do. However, great work should be honored with great praise. These guys came through, assessed the situation, and delivered. If you need any removal done, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Rebecca Lawson
reviews.text: Brian and the rest of the crew did phenomenal job removing our trees. I would recommend that you give them a call for any tree removal jobs that you have. They went over and above my expectations! Clean up was exceptional.

reviews.author: Randy Linden
reviews.text: Brian and the crew did a fantastic job removing a huge tree from our backyard that was next to fencing and other trees and shrubs without damaging any of that. Their clean up was excellent as well as the price. Highly recommend B & B Tree Service. They are great to work with!

reviews.author: David Eakins
reviews.text: This was a amazing crew very professional. I will use them if I have any further tree work that needs to be done. Could not beat there prices trust me I checked around and in this case a lower price did not reflect in the work. Im very satisfied. If you want the best call the best thats what I did with B&B. You will not regret your decision

reviews.author: Brianna Yeager
reviews.text: Really good job for a good price! Started to downpour during the job and they still completed it. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kellie Szenderski
reviews.text: B&B Tree Service spent all day at our house yesterday cleaning some very neglected trees at the house we just bought in Wilmington. I would give Budd/Brian and their crew a 10 out 10 rating! From the quote to the finished product, they were attentive, detailed, great communicators and true tree lovers. They listened to us every step of the way and it looks like we have a brand new house totally opening it up to the light! These guys rock!

reviews.author: Samuel Herren
reviews.text: Great services for tree cutting and cleanup. The B&B team was very responsive in coming to my home, giving me the quote, then being flexible with my schedule to start and finish the job in under 5 hours. They removed 2 large trees in the backyard that were very close to the house and have been anxiety inducing for years during coastal NC hurricane season.

reviews.author: Rachael Mott
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Great hard working team, honest and reasonably priced. Had 4 tricky pines that needed to come down, they did a great job in the removal and clean up.

reviews.author: Dana Digit
reviews.text: B&B were fantastic! I had several trees taken down, pruned and stumps ground. The guys were responsive, quick to schedule, on time and did outstanding work. I am so happy with the work and suggestions to help some of my other trees thrive. Highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: melissa Wheeler
reviews.text: These guys are very hard working and great professionals. They cut 8 trees down between my brother and fathers house. They were near the homes as well as the buildings and not 1 limb hit anything. They had one tough week with there Bob cat messing up as well as there truck but that did not stop them from being on time and keeping there word. I would recommend these guys to anyone if they ask me.

reviews.author: jeffery scott
reviews.text: B&B did a great job trimming our oak trees and removing a stump. They were very friendly and patient with the many questions I asked. They also showed up when they said they would, which means a lot these days. Price seemed very reasonable. I would recommend using them.

reviews.author: kevin stone
reviews.text: B&B Tree Services was referred to me through a family friend who has used them a few times. They were able to come over and bid the job within 1 day of calling for estimates. I took bids from 4 different local companies. I didnt only choose B&B bc their price was way more fair than the others but bc someone who i consider family highly recommended them. My tree job was not an easy one either. The tree was big, and dead, and right up against my one story house with a large branch hanging directly over the house. The crew showed up early in the morning and stayed on it until the job was completely finished, yard/driveway raked up and their work area left cleaner than when they arrived. They cut the stump down really low for me to help make taking the stump out as smooth as possible. B&B know their stuff&strategically cuts your trees down safely as possible. I will have them cut more trees for me in the future!

reviews.author: Tom Rilling
reviews.text: Very pleased with B & B. They did a great job trimming our huge oak tree along with some other tree trimming and removal. Everything was cleaned up after so you couldn't even tell they had been there. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Lee Henderson
reviews.text: I highly recommend B&B tree service.They did a great job removing a very large and extremely dangerous dead oak tree without any harm to anything or anyone. They showed up when they said they would and cleaned up the yard after for a very reasonable price. Very nice people and very hard working.

reviews.author: Chris Sciortino
reviews.text: Microburst came through our neighborhood a few weeks back. I called the next day and they were able to come out the day after to give me a quote. Quote was very reasonable even in a tough scenario of one tree uprooted leaning on another. They came out on the day and at the time they said they would. They also gave me a trusted contact for a stump grinder. Would absolutely recommend these guys for your tree needs.

reviews.author: Mike Jones
reviews.text: I have used othere tree services around time but none of them can compare to B&B. They worked really hard and got everything cleaned up in one day. The best Tree service your going to find. 10/10

reviews.author: Jane & Ray
reviews.text: These guys are the best! They showed up on time and got the job done. Our yard looks fantastic now that all the trees are trimmed back. Great job!! Would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Ayden Boswell
reviews.text: BJ & Allen did an amazing job trimming & cutting down my dead trees in my front yard. They cleaned everything up too. Very sweet & pleasant guys. Definitely recommend all these amazing guys. Great prices too.

reviews.author: Mikquel
reviews.text: I was referred to B&B by a coworker who also used their service. I was told not to bother calling around and take their word on this one. This was the crew I wanted to tend to my yard. I'm more than satisfied with the service, professionalism, they definitely perfected their craft. Thank you again guys.

reviews.author: barbara holland
reviews.text: These guys were wonderful. Prompt, fair, neat, and worked with great teamwork. I was impressed with how they were able to bring down large limbs like they were a feather (in a tight space). I will definitely recommend them, in fact I need more business cards. My neighbors were impressed and are asking for information.

reviews.author: Josh Marks
reviews.text: I just want to say thank you to this tree company! They are very reliable and very professional. They did everything that i needed them to and got it done in a timely manner. Definitely will be using them again

reviews.author: Morgan Skye
reviews.text: Very professional! Showed up on time and got the job done! Made everything in my yard look amazing! Even planted some new trees for me! Totally would recommend them for all your needs!

reviews.author: Christopher Jacobs
reviews.text: Quick to respond and come out. Went over process, risks, and options to get the job done. Fit my tree cutting in within a quicker than reasonable time. Great job and went above and beyond to clean up after themselves.

reviews.author: Jenn
reviews.text: Very nice men, highly recommend, very on point, don't charge an arm and leg to get the job done. Very respectful. Hard to find good honest people these days. I will use again when I need any tree service done.

reviews.author: Luis Rodriguez
reviews.text: The team did a fantastic job. Spent many hours doing the job right while making sure that the trees remain healthy. Definitely will use B&B again.

reviews.author: Beth Burgin
reviews.text: Bud, Brian and crew were awesome. Efficient, safe, super job working around the landscaped areas and excellent on clean-up. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Iza Pasternak
reviews.text: Great service, professional, they came on time and took care cleaning after the tree removal. Outstanding service, would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Daniel Chapoton
reviews.text: This company removed a large tree leaning against the house and covering a power line in a skilled and confident manner. So impressed with the result and at the right cost!

reviews.author: Serge Stroehmer
reviews.text: They were quick to respond, they came out and took care of my tree trimming and tree removal needs, l definitely recommend B&B!

reviews.author: Benji Nobles
reviews.text: These gentlemen were very professional from the start. The quote was reasonable and once they started I couldn’t have been more impressed with their service. Would definitely call them again

reviews.author: Grayson
reviews.text: Very professional. On time. Had 2 pine trees taken down and the stumps grinded away. In and out and left no Trace. Thank you B&B Tree Service!

reviews.author: Amy Stellhorn
reviews.text: Removed 2 trees and hauled them away. Very friendly. Left the yard looking great. Would definitely recommend and will definitely use again

reviews.author: Rock Lockwood
reviews.text: The Service Was Very Profesional And The Prices Were Reasonable And Affordable. What I Like is, There Not There To Milk Your Clock, They Are There To Do a Job. I Was Very Pleased With The Work.

reviews.author: Dylan Bennett
reviews.text: Quick to respond and come out. My tree cutting in within a quicker than reasonable time. Great job and went above and beyond to clean up after themselves.

reviews.author: April Schaefer
reviews.text: Guys did a great job dropping trees. Skillfully took down several pines some near or over the house. Happy customer.

reviews.author: Ed Thomas
reviews.text: Great price. Arrived on time/early. Did all work agreed upon. Cleanup went so well you would never know they had been there. Super friendly, too !

reviews.author: Matt D
reviews.text: It doesn’t get any better than this. Quick, punctual and friendly crew exceeded my expectations. Not even a leaf left in the yard. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joe Santos
reviews.text: Guys were on time and did a great job removing the tree and cleaning everything up before they left.
